title: Documents, rules and officialdom
intro: The vocabulary of forms, offices and queues. Two false friends worth noting: la carpeta is a folder, not a carpet, and asistir means to attend, not to assist.

entries.note: los documentos loosely means your papers or ID.
la visa or el visado is the visa; la credencial or el carnet an ID card.
firmar is to sign. The company sense is formal and less common than la empresa.

ex.es: Trabaja en una firma de abogados.
ex.en: She works at a law firm.

entries.note: llenar un formulario is to fill in a form; rellenar in Spain.

ex.es: Llene el formulario con letra clara.
ex.en: Fill in the form in clear writing.

entries.warn: Not a carpet. A carpet is la alfombra. Also the computer folder.

ex.es: Los papeles están en la carpeta azul.
ex.en: The papers are in the blue folder.

entries.note: Plural leyes. legal and ilegal as expected; la regla is a rule.

ex.es: La ley cambió el año pasado.

ex.en: The rules have to be respected.

ex.es: Necesito una regla para la línea.
ex.en: I need a ruler for the line.

entries.note: con permiso is the everyday excuse me — see unit 5.

ex.en: He asked permission to leave early.

entries.note: The word on every sign: prohibido fumar, prohibido el paso.
dejar is the everyday alternative — see unit 28.

ex.es: No permiten mascotas en el edificio.
ex.en: They don't allow pets in the building.

entries.warn: A false friend. To assist someone is ayudar or atender. asistir a una reunión is to attend a meeting.

ex.en: More than a hundred people attended.

entries.note: el sello or la estampilla is a stamp; el sobre an envelope.

ex.es: La oficina de correos cierra a la una.
ex.en: The post office closes at one.
Write the address down for me.
We're going in the wrong direction.

entries.note: hacer un trámite is to deal with a piece of bureaucracy. A word you will need constantly.
hacer fila is to queue, alongside hacer cola — see unit 21.

ex.en: There was a very long queue.

ex.es: Nos sentamos en la primera fila.
ex.en: We sat in the front row.

entries.note: gobernar is to govern; el presidente the president.
el IVA is VAT; pagar impuestos to pay tax.
poner una multa is to issue a fine.

ex.es: Me pusieron una multa por estacionar.

entries.note: Plural jueces. el abogado is the lawyer — see unit 17.
See unit 36 for derecho meaning straight ahead, and unit 1 for deber as a verb.
